name: Phase Out applies Runeshroud (#5772)
contract: Phase Out 500671 reads 'Disappear from sight, entering an improved stealth for $560269d and applying Runeshroud.' It triggers 560269, whose effects are a movement-speed aura and stealth. Effect 2 is SPELL_EFFECT_ASCENSION_MODIFY_COOLDOWN on Runeshroud 500288 with base points 0 and die sides 1, so the cast changes that cooldown by 1 ms and never applies aura 500288. #5772 reports that Phase Out does not apply Runeshroud. Expected: after Phase Out, the Runemaster has both the improved-stealth aura 560269 and Runeshroud 500288.
